script.title: The vacuum the bag business turned down
script.hook_line: Manufacturers in Europe rejected James Dyson’s bagless design over replacement bag profits.
script.close_line: The bagless design manufacturers refused to license became the United Kingdom’s bestselling vacuum.

segments.say: Manufacturers in Europe rejected James Dyson’s bagless design over replacement bag profits.
His Hoover had a bag that clogged before it was even full.
The paper was supposed to let air through and hold the dust, but dust clogged the pores and the suction dropped.
He had seen an industrial cyclone at a sawmill, and he wondered if the same method would work in a vacuum.
He strapped a cardboard cyclone to his upright vacuum in place of the bag.
The prototypes got more elaborate, and after five thousand one hundred and twenty-seven, he had a bagless vacuum that never lost suction.
He tried to sell the patent for the cyclone technology.
He struggled to find a licensee for his red and blue prototype, and as he put it, “I knocked on lots of doors with no success.”

quotes.words: I knocked on lots of doors with no success.

segments.say: So after manufacturers in Europe turned down the licence, he decided to launch the vacuum under his own name.
Market research suggested that people wouldn’t like a clear container for the dust.
Dyson and his team made the container clear anyway.
The Dyson Dee See Oh One went on sale in the United Kingdom in nineteen ninety-three.
And the clear dust container turned out to be popular.
Within eighteen months, it was the bestselling vacuum cleaner in the United Kingdom.
The bagless design manufacturers refused to license became the United Kingdom’s bestselling vacuum.
